t: Johnstones matt black chalkboard paint is a water-based interior paint designed to create a durable, non-reflective writing surface. This versatile paint is ideal for transforming wood and metal in workshops, offices, or domestic kitchens into functional chalkboard areas. It provides an attractive, smooth black finish, becoming touch-dry in 1-2 hours and ready for recoating within 2-4 hours. A 2.5Ltr tin offers excellent coverage, up to 30m², ensuring efficient project completion for trade professionals.
b: Formulated for Interior Wood & Metal Use
Recoat in 2-4 Hours for Efficient Projects
